description: This PHP file defines a class 'ImportViewLast' that extends 'ImportView' and is responsible for displaying the last step of an import process in the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM system. It handles rendering the import summary, including record counts, errors, duplicates, and related lists, as well as generating JavaScript for dynamic page interactions.

classes.name: ImportViewLast
classes.description: Represents the view for the last step of the import process, extending 'ImportView', responsible for rendering import summaries, related records, and providing user interactions for finalizing import operations.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to render the import summary page, including record counts, errors, duplicates, and associated lists, as well as JavaScript for page interactions.

methods.name: getListViewResults
methods.description: Builds and returns the HTML for the list view displaying imported records for the current import.

methods.name: getListViewTableFromFile
methods.description: Generates an HTML table from a specified import file for error or duplicate records.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Provides JavaScript code for managing tab navigation and table refresh actions within the import summary interface.

methods.name: _addToProspectListButton
methods.description: Returns HTML for a button that allows adding imported prospects to a target list.
